## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or decision.

## Validation

Record checks actually run, exact versions where relevant, and remaining limits.

- [ ] Targets `develop`, or explains an agreed exception.
- [ ] Preserves provider truth, explicit command targets and safe unavailable handling.
- [ ] Updates relevant documentation, migration notes and changelog.
- [ ] Contains no private entities, credentials, home topology or operational records.
- [ ] Preserves third-party rights and is compatible with the applicable licence scope.
- [ ] Clearly distinguishes planned, implemented, tested and released behavior.

## Compatibility and recovery

Explain affected providers/configuration and recovery steps, or state why these are not applicable.
